title: Meta executives could earn $1 billion each if they hit goals in pursuit of a $9 trillion valuation | Fortune
summary: Meta extends moonshot-level stock grants to a broader group of senior leaders, not just the CEO, to incentivize achieving a significant market capitalization growth. This move could lead to speculative compensation packages for non-CEO C-suite executives.
sentiment_reason: The initiative is negative due to the speculative nature of the compensation packages and the pressure it puts on multiple executives to achieve a high-risk, high-reward goal.
